prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1159; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented for evaluation following a rear-end motor vehicle collision and was found to have a closed fracture of the distal radius of the left wrist. Initial imaging confirmed a non-displaced fracture, and the wrist was immobilized in a short arm cast. The patient also reported neck and upper back soreness, which was managed conservatively with over-the-counter analgesics and home stretching instructions.

Over the course of treatment, the patient attended 19 visits. Follow-up radiographs showed appropriate alignment and progressive bony healing. The cast was removed at the appropriate interval, and a structured physical therapy program was started to restore range of motion, grip strength, and forearm rotation. Pain and swelling improved steadily, and the patient was compliant with the home exercise program.

At discharge, the patient had regained most of the functional range of motion in the affected wrist, with residual mild stiffness on extreme wrist extension. No further surgical intervention is anticipated. The patient was advised to continue a home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen.
